title: Will the Eighth Circuit issue a published decision in an Indian Country criminal jurisdiction case before 2027-01-01?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit issues a published opinion deciding a case whose central question is Indian Country criminal jurisdiction (18 U.S.C. 1151-1153 or the McGirt/Castro-Huerta line), per the court's own published-opinions docket or Turtle Talk's case tracker, before 2027-01-01; NO otherwise.
falsifier: Wrong if the Eighth Circuit's own published-opinions docket or Turtle Talk's tracker disagrees with the recorded probability's implied side.
